title: Due date and priority in the domain: migration 0002, validation, ordering, filters
description:
Source of truth: docs/thoughts/2026-09-17-increment-02-organise.md → 'Migration 0002', 'Domain', 'The list page → Ordering', 'Validation messages', 'Definitions of done → Epic 1'. Read it and .tick/learnings.md first. Existing code: src/lib/db/*, src/lib/tasks/* (types, validate with parseTaskInput/formDataToRaw/parseTaskId/submittedValues, repository), docs/current/data-model.md.

Deliver (domain only; no UI in this tick; the existing pages and e2e must keep working unchanged):
- src/lib/db/migrations/0002_task_schedule.ts: `migration0002` version 2 name "task_schedule": ALTER TABLE tasks ADD COLUMN due_on TEXT NULL; ALTER TABLE tasks ADD COLUMN priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2 CHECK (priority IN (1, 2, 3)); CREATE INDEX tasks_due_idx ON tasks(done_at, due_on, priority). Append to MIGRATIONS in migrate.ts.
- src/lib/tasks/types.ts: `export type Priority = 1 | 2 | 3;` Task gains `dueOn: string | null; priority: Priority;` TaskInput gains `dueOn: string | null; priority: Priority;`.
- src/lib/tasks/validate.ts: `PRIORITY_LABELS: Record<Priority, string> = {1: "High", 2: "Normal", 3: "Low"}`; `parseDueOn(raw: unknown): { ok: true; value: string | null } | { ok: false; error: string }` (non-string or empty/whitespace → null; else must match /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/ and round-trip through `new Date(v + "T00:00:00Z").toISOString().slice(0,10) === v`, otherwise error "Due must be a date (YYYY-MM-DD)."); `parsePriority(raw: unknown): { ok: true; value: Priority } | { ok: false; error }` (undefined, null or "" → 2 (the default, so forms without the field keep working); "1"/"2"/"3" or 1/2/3 → that; anything else → "Priority must be high, normal or low."). parseTaskInput(raw: { title?, notes?, dueOn?, priority? }) now also validates these and reports every failing field (TaskInputErrors gains dueOn? and priority?); formDataToRaw also reads "dueOn" and "priority"; submittedValues returns dueOn and priority as submitted strings too.
- src/lib/tasks/repository.ts: rows map due_on→dueOn, priority→priority; createTask/updateTask persist them; `export type ListFilter = { show?: "open" | "done" | "all"; q?: string }`; `listTasks(db, filter: ListFilter = {})`: show "open" (default) → done: [] ; "done" → open: []; "all" → both; q (trimmed, non-empty) → WHERE lower(title) LIKE '%' || lower(?) || '%' on both; open ordering `ORDER BY (due_on IS NULL) ASC, due_on ASC, priority ASC, created_at DESC, id DESC`; done unchanged. `export function isOverdue(task: Pick<Task, "dueOn" | "doneAt">, today: string): boolean` (dueOn set, doneAt null, dueOn < today as strings).
- Update every existing test/fixture that constructs TaskInput (add dueOn: null, priority: 2) so pnpm test stays green; existing actions in src/app compile because parseTaskInput now returns the fields.
Tests (test-first):
- src/lib/db/open.integration.test.ts: ledger now [1 tasks, 2 task_schedule]; PRAGMA table_info(tasks) includes due_on and priority; applying MIGRATIONS on a db that had only migration0001 applied (call applyMigrations(db, [migration0001]) first) applies exactly 1 more.
- src/lib/tasks/validate.test.ts: parseDueOn: "" → null, "2026-09-30" → ok, "2026-02-30" → error, "30/09/2026" → error, 42 → null; parsePriority: undefined → 2, "1" → 1, 3 → 3, "4" → error, "high" → error; parseTaskInput reports dueOn and priority errors alongside title errors.
- src/lib/tasks/repository.integration.test.ts: createTask stores dueOn "2026-09-30" and priority 1; open ordering for the spec's set: create (undated normal, older), (undated normal, newest), (undated high), (due 2026-01-02 high), (due 2026-01-01 normal) with fake timers advancing between creates, expect open titles in order [due 2026-01-01 normal, due 2026-01-02 high, undated high, undated normal newest, undated normal older]; show "done" → open []; show "all" → both; q "milk" matches "Buy MILK" and not "Bread"; isOverdue cases: due yesterday open → true, due today → false, done yesterday → false, undated → false.
- Docs: docs/current/data-model.md: add the two columns to the tasks table, the new index, migration 0002 to the ledger, the new open ordering rule; update the erDiagram Mermaid block (adds due_on, priority) — this makes the data-model stamp stale, which pnpm docs:check reports as FAIL 'stale'; that is expected for this tick: the orchestrator re-renders at close-out. Run `pnpm docs:check` and confirm the ONLY failure is the stale data-model stamp. Mention the ordering rule in how/tasks.md's mechanism section (one sentence) if it states the old rule.
Files likely touched: src/lib/db/migrations/0002_task_schedule.ts (new), src/lib/db/migrate.ts, src/lib/tasks/{types,validate,repository}.ts and their tests, src/lib/db/open.integration.test.ts, docs/current/data-model.md, docs/current/how/tasks.md, docs/current/how/persistence.md (migration list if it has one).
Run: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm docs:check
acceptance_criteria: pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint, pnpm test pass with all listed cases; pnpm docs:check reports no shape problems and the only diagram failure is 'stale data-model'; existing src/app compiles unchanged; parsePriority defaults to 2 when absent.
